svg.title: Birth chart wheel computed by xalen chart
svg.desc: Indian independence, 15 August 1947, 00:00 IST (UTC+05:30), Delhi. Sidereal zodiac, Lahiri (Chitrapaksha) ayanamsa, Placidus houses. Planets at their computed longitudes.
